why: One major reviewer, TechRadar, answers this with tested picks across two guides and explicitly flags 32GB models (Nank Runner Diver2 Pro, Shokz OpenSwim Pro, Jabees 7Seven), but neither page is organised around the 32GB filter. The rest are single-product brand-store pages (Suunto, Dreame), retailer listings for no-name budget units, one untested listicle, and two unreadable pages. No page compiles all 32GB options with prices, so a focused comparison could get in, but it would compete with TechRadar rather than own the search.
